desc:
⚠️IMPORTANT: ⚠️This game is not related to any public bathroom games, it is simply a level of the backrooms I liked and recreated.

⚠️ANNOUNCEMENT⚠️ this game is meant to be played on MAX GRAPHICS SETTINGS. If you play on the lowest setting. it will look terrible, so dont blame me for that.

August 2026 update: Due to the horrible business decisions at Roblox, the easter egg level is only playable for 16+ users. I have also quit development on this game and moved on to Blender instead.

A recreation of level 37 of the backrooms. i tried to make the graphics as high as possible.

In this game you can explore lots of rooms and spaces! Make sure you've checked everything out!

This game contains easter-eggs. To find these portals you need to follow sound clues. 

This game does NOT contain jumpscares. I might add another version where it does contain entities. 



⭕Version WITH entities (WIP): 
https://www.roblox.com/games/11834852128/The-Pool-Rooms-HD-survival-mode
